policy.manifest_scope: Public, user-facing, or automation-facing tool entrypoints are declared in tools/manifest.json.
policy.allowed_unmanifested_scope: Repo-local compatibility shims, release/operator scripts, fixture generators, one-off migration helpers, and maintenance audits may stay outside the manifest when their disposition is documented here.
policy.review_rule: A new direct file under tools/ with .py or .sh suffix must either be added to tools/manifest.json or added here with a disposition and rationale.
